patch_description: Add a lightweight directional hysteresis gate to the predictive consensus stage. The current alpha-beta update remains highly responsive, but its reported level can still alternate direction whenever short-lived innovations pull the target across the prediction. This edit requires two samples of consistent opposite-direction evidence before publishing a reversal, while allowing large, Kalman-supported turns to pass immediately. Holding the reported level during unconfirmed turns eliminates noise-induced sign changes without adding a fixed moving-average delay. The tracker itself continues updating during the hold, so genuine trend changes are released with minimal latency.
